run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to compare an evolved affine transform solver against the AlgoTune baseline and measure speedup
run_run_with_timeout: run any function with a configurable timeout using run_with_timeout to prevent hanging execution
calculate_speedup: calculate the speedup ratio between a baseline and evolved solution using calculate_speedup
run_evaluate_stage1: run evaluate_stage1 to perform a quick basic functionality check on an evolved solver program
run_setup_algotune_paths: run setup_algotune_paths to dynamically locate and add the AlgoTune installation to the Python path
